text: for specific use. I bought these because the dimensions were perfect for the holiday bread loaves I was making and giving as gifts.  They are plastic, however, nicer than a paper plate... I would have preferred  glass, but nothing fit better than these.  I purchased some knives and included some special packets of apple cider.  Wrapped all in cellophane and raphia ribbon.  They were beautiful and well received.
